mcq.q: Two vectors point the same way but one is twice as long. Which is unchanged?
mcq.why: Cosine normalises by length, so scaling one vector leaves it unchanged.

mcq.q: A detector has 95% recall and 1% false positives; the condition occurs in 0.1% of cases. Most alerts are…
mcq.why: With a 0.1% base rate, false alarms from the 99.9% negatives vastly outnumber true detections (Bayes).
